qualification: Independent exact-source Word comparisons and reviewed initial controls are retained. Combined qualification passed 1,781 normal-build tests, 34 real-HTTP PDF requests / 52 exact native golden pages, six actual Playground cleanup/reuse requests / eight exact native golden pages, and 16 negative HTTP cases without PDF output. Representative cases cover standard PDF and PDF/A-1b/2b/3b; measured Word anchors differ by at most 0.21 pt. Existing protected golden files were not replaced. These results describe unreleased source, not arbitrary DOCX support.
